title: Keep unquoted Git blame peels out of path argument positions
outcome: The unquoted Git peel exception applies only where blame's syntax unambiguously places the operand in a revision role.
acceptance: Production control-request classification refuses an unquoted peel in blame's single-path and legacy path/revision forms, while preserving ordinary read-only blame and quoted literal arguments.
If blame keeps unquoted revision peels, an explicit revision/path separator is required and covered by behavior tests; no shell expansion or execution/write authority is added.
